quotes.text: This test must pass for your reader to process payments and receive updates.
You must connect both cables before inserting the reader into the dock.
Fixed a bug where the reader app occasionally experienced auto-disconnects when in countertop mode.

old_evidence.text: If you use software acceptance, see the [Terminal bundle release notes]
The reader receives updates automatically from Stripe when not in use.

findings: The 2026-11-07 full capture is a device operations and firmware reference. New table revisions are reader app 2.46.4.0, firmware 5.01.06.01 with .eftpos for AU, ROM 1.8.9.4 and HKSG in the previous SG configuration row.

The 2026-09-08 2.45.7.0 entry specifically corrects long translated tip-selection text and occasional auto-disconnects in countertop mode. Four other post-May changelog entries are generic fixes and improvements; 2.46.4.0 is dated October 20.

The device prerequisites and operator flow persist: internet-supported integrations, recommended server-driven mode, connectivity for payment/updates, powered assigned-location midnight updates/restarts, and both dock cables before insertion. The payment sound distinguishes tap from chip/swipe, without distinguishing tap success from tap failure.
substantive_changes: The 2026-11-07 version table advances reader app 2.41.2.0 to 2.46.4.0, firmware 5.01.03.00 to 5.01.06.01, and ROM 1.8.4 to 1.8.9.4. The AU suffix and configuration codes persist. The SG row is relabeled HKSG while availability prose remains unchanged.

The current capture adds May 26 through October 20, 2026 release notes, including the September 8 translation/countertop disconnect fixes. The old software-acceptance route is absent in this representation. Keep it dated and do not infer discontinuation.

Table alignment, trailing spaces, explicit step numbering, copy punctuation, and time zone spelling are presentational. The battery-life documentation retargets the device-specific specs anchor, and the image changes from a local asset to a remote asset.
historical_claims_to_preserve: The May 1 table uses reader app 2.41.2.0, firmware 5.01.03.00 (AU .eftpos), ROM 1.8.4 and SG for the szzz_prod_apac_off_v4 configuration. The May changelog points software-acceptance users to the Terminal bundle release notes.

Preserve compatibility with four named SDK integrations plus server-driven, which Stripe recommends; retain network/Stripe connectivity checks and conditional tamper handling (under warranty, or through Connect platform provider).

Software updates occur automatically while idle and a missing required update can prevent payments, with assigned-location midnight updates/restart and daily POS disconnection documented. Preserve the on-power condition and manual reboot check. No account rollout or reader installation follows from an as-of table.

The right LED array reports reader state, the left battery status, and the text-only table omits the visual codes. Tap success and failure produce the same beep; chip and swipe are silent in the sound table. Both cables must precede Ethernet docking.
conflicts: The new November firmware table groups HK with SG at line 134 while the same capture’s availability banner at line 8 still lists 24 markets with SG and no HK. Preserve the table exactly and leave the mismatch visible. This is not sufficient for an HK availability conclusion.

The existing summary line 13 says all 5 SDKs plus server-driven, but both captures list only the four named SDK integrations (JavaScript, iOS, Android and React Native) plus server-driven. Server-driven is recommended and uses the API instead of an SDK (new raw lines 10-14 and old raw lines 9-13).

The 2.41.2.0/5.01.03.00 tuple currently presented as latest in the source and its Terminal concept/index descriptors is the May table. Date that tuple (including ROM 1.8.4), surface the November values and keep the WisePOS E reference independent of S700/S710 software scope.
unresolved_questions: The 2026-11-07 regional firmware row includes HK, but the same capture’s availability list excludes it. This evidence leaves HK availability unresolved.

answers.Q1: The 2026-11-07 full capture for https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/readers/bbpos-wisepos-e documents an internet countertop smart reader supporting JavaScript, iOS, Android and React Native SDKs plus recommended server-driven Stripe API integration (new raw lines 8-14). Operators must connect both dock cables before inserting the reader, and Stripe-connectivity diagnostics must pass for payments and updates (new raw lines 73-92 and new raw lines 102-110). Stripe sends idle updates, required updates can block payment acceptance if missed, and the reader restarts daily at assigned-location midnight for PCI with POS disconnection every morning. It should stay powered for automatic updates, or can be rebooted to check manually (new raw lines 114-122). Older firmware, app and ROM values cited in source-stripe-terminal-bbpos-wisepos-e correspond to the 2026-05-01 capture’s 2.41.2.0/5.01.03.00/1.8.4 table (old raw lines 119-135). In November, the table reads 2.46.4.0/5.01.06.01/1.8.9.4 with AU .eftpos, and the September 8 2.45.7.0 entry documents translated tip text and countertop disconnect fixes (new raw lines 128-148). Historical compatibility, power, sound, diagnostics and update rules remain corroborated by the old raw (old raw lines 9-13, old raw lines 57-92 and old raw lines 101-117).
answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/readers/bbpos-wisepos-e, the 2026-11-07 software/firmware/ROM tuple, the HKSG group replacing SG alone, and the five May 26–October 20 changelog entries are substantive documentary changes to source-stripe-terminal-bbpos-wisepos-e (old raw lines 127-143 and new raw lines 128-164). The November availability banner still has SG and no HK, so the new firmware grouping cannot establish Hong Kong deployment availability (new raw lines 5-14 and new raw lines 128-136). Preserve the AU .eftpos distinction, the 2026-05-01 earlier version tuple, and the old software-acceptance bundle-release-notes link as historical guidance (old raw lines 127-143); the newer heading and absence of that link establish no retirement (new raw lines 138-147). Headings, table spacing, diagnostics numbering and wording edits are presentational (old raw lines 66-94 and new raw lines 67-94). The battery-life specs retarget and image asset link change are navigation/presentation (old raw line 7, old raw line 39, new raw line 8 and new raw line 40). Keep the companion WisePOS E setup route and refresh the reciprocal stripe-terminal and Stripe index descriptors with dated WisePOS E values, while routing to both raw captures. Correct the 'all 5 SDKs' line to the four SDKs plus recommended server-driven (old raw lines 9-13 and new raw lines 10-14).
